proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Register and Controller
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: Click or keyboard-activate the rating button twice, then submit; the handler must receive rating 3 rather than 1. Verify the title is also registered.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: A rating picker still needs a semantic accessible name and keyboard focus; wrapping an inaccessible custom control in Controller does not make it accessible.
